facts.business: Innovana Thinklabs Limited develops and operates consumer-focused software products for system optimization, security, privacy, productivity, and digital utilities, while also operating in astrology services, fitness, gaming, infrastructure, and renewable energy through its subsidiaries.

segments.name: Information Technology, Software and Digital Services

key_risks: Rapid technological advancements leading to obsolescence
Intense competition in the global market
Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates affecting global operations
Intellectual property theft and piracy risks
Changes in Government policies and legislation
facts.related_party_note: Details of loans, advances, guarantees and investments made by the Company and its subsidiaries under Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 during the financial year are disclosed in the Notes to the Financial Statements.
